text_block_list.text:
—Let us begin the review session immediately.
We'll analyze everything step by step, right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Is the recording ready yet? I need to review how the race unfolded... and check my form too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: My strength wasn't enough this time, but... I have to turn this defeat into a stepping stone for the next.

text_block_list.text:
Faster, stronger.
I have to surpass who I am right now.

That scenery is...
way further ahead than where we are right now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Until that promise is fulfilled... let's keep moving forward!
